stories.title: Brain Lock Schema and TTL Contract
stories.description: Define the lock structure for Brain execution including fields for lock_id, owner (process/agent), acquired_at, expires_at (TTL), status (active/expired/released), last_heartbeat, and correlation_id. Establish validation and persistence contract for lock lifecycle management.

stories.title: Lock Acquisition with TTL Enforcement
stories.description: Implement core lock acquisition logic that sets TTL on lock creation, prevents concurrent acquisition when active, and allows takeover when lock is expired. Ensure atomic check-and-set behavior to avoid race conditions.

stories.title: Heartbeat Tracking and Staleness Signaling
stories.description: Implement heartbeat updates from active Brain executions and detection logic that flags locks as stale when last_heartbeat exceeds a defined threshold. This story produces staleness signals only and does not perform recovery or unlock actions.

stories.title: Lock Management Interface (Internal API)
stories.description: Expose internal functions for lock acquire, renew (heartbeat update), release, status check, and forced unlock. Enforce ownership rules and admin override constraints, and integrate audit logging for all lock state transitions.

stories.title: Lock Lifecycle Testing and Integration
stories.description: Develop unit and integration tests covering lock acquisition, TTL expiration, heartbeat updates, stale lock signaling, forced unlock, and concurrent execution race conditions. Validate integration within Brain runner execution flow.
